profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Meta
profile.summary:
I work on a distributed stream processing platform. I also occasionally write:

- Quora: https://www.quora.com/profile/Taejun-TJ-Lee
- Medium: https://tjlee0909.medium.com/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Tupperware (Twine)
Owner of gang-semantics used in Meta's AI distributed-inference platform, currently serving inference for MuseSpark and MuseSpark 1.1
- https://ai.meta.com/blog/introducing-muse-spark-meta-model-api/
- https://ai.meta.com/blog/introducing-muse-spark-msl/

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description: I was the lead on the stateful-processing run mode of Google's planet-scale stream data processing platform.

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead on Productivity Engineering team.

My group owned Box's entire in-house CI/CD system.

Among other things, my team built and open-sourced ClusterRunner (https://www.clusterrunner.com/).
I gave a talk about it at the Google Test Automation Conference in 2016 here: https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=V7fhx1i4qPE&t=286s

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description: Full stack web application development with emphasis on the payment system.
